# Watched workflows — THE single source for the master watchdog.
#
# Consumed by scripts/check-master-green.sh (one line per workflow NAME,
# exactly as the workflow's `name:` field spells it). scripts/check-
# watched-workflows.sh is the drift guard: every workflow that triggers on
# a schedule or on master pushes MUST appear here, and every entry here
# MUST name a real workflow file. Add a new scheduled/push-triggered
# workflow → add its name here IN THE SAME CHANGE.
#
# Release draft is deliberately absent: it triggers on tags only, so a
# master-health watchdog watching it would page on tag-time failures that
# are not master reds.
CI
Nightly Flake Canary
Nightly Fuzz
Release integrity
Master Red Alert
